purpose: Teach: 埋まっ/労組/貸出/定休/代え/所存/営ん/取調べ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、机が書類で埋まっていたぞ
lines.en: Your father—during the founding years, his desk was buried in documents.
lines.style: Quiet, measured recollection. Warm nostalgic weight on the memory. Unhurried pace. Voice settles into the weight of the past, neither celebratory nor sorrowful—just truthful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは労組とも友好的でした
lines.en: Yes. He had a good relationship with the union too.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation with steady eye contact. Calm, direct. No performance—just honest acknowledgment of inherited values. Slight nod in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員寮で備品の貸出をなさったぞ
lines.en: Your father—in the staff dormitory, he lent out company equipment to people.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful pause before the verb. Voice lingers on the kindness of the act. Slow enough to let the generosity breathe. Slight fade at the end, as if settling into old affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの定休にこだわるお姿勢、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. I've inherited his commitment to keeping regular holidays—his stance on that.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Each phrase weighted equally—no rushing. Voice carries the responsibility of continuity without strain. Direct, grounded, as if speaking a vow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商材を代えての勝負をなさった
lines.en: Your father—he took a gamble by changing what the company sold.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost hushed. Voice carries respect for the risk-taking. Pace is deliberate, leaving space around the word 'gamble.' Trailing off slightly, like sitting with the courage of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの百年企業を目指す所存です
lines.en: Yes. I intend to continue pursuing his vision—to build a company that will last a hundred years.
lines.style: Strong, clear intention without arrogance. Steady rhythm. Voice carries both humility and resolve. The words land like a declaration grounded in duty, not ambition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんが営んできた事業、私が引き継ぐ
lines.en: The business your father built—I will carry it forward.
lines.style: Simple, profound. No extra words or flourish. Voice is calm and clear, the tone of someone accepting a weight they understand and honor. Slight pause before 'I' to mark the shift of responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社内不正を取調べる体制、整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll establish a proper system for investigating any misconduct within the company.
lines.style: Clear, practical, final. Voice shifts to the present and future—less reflection, more action. Steady and measured. The closing note is firm but not cold, as if sealing the inheritance with integrity.
